svg.title: Malonic ester synthesis: Mechanistic boundary / grouped stage
svg.desc: EtO2CCH(Et)CO2Et + hydrolysis / acidification → HO2CCH(Et)CO2H + 2 EtOH. Each ester undergoes addition–elimination hydrolysis and protonation. The individual saponification stages are detailed in the ester-hydrolysis entry.

g.text: Process model: no unique microscopic electron-arrow sequence asserted.
